formulas.description: Append GSD Approval Confirmed; string to Opportunity.Required_Approval_Processes__c field to indicate that GSD was approved
formulas.name: GSDStringConfirmedAppended
formulas.expression: SUBSTITUTE(IF(CONTAINS({!recordId.Required_Approval_Processes__c}, 'GSD Approval Confirmed;'), {!recordId.Required_Approval_Processes__c}, {!recordId.Required_Approval_Processes__c} + 'GSD Approval Confirmed;'), 'GSD Approval Rejected;', '')

formulas.description: Append GSD Approval Rejected; string to Opportunity.Required_Approval_Processes__c field to indicate that GSD was declined
